BACKYARD CHASE — SEEDANCE 2.5. Hyper-dynamic photorealistic suburban action-comedy, bright late-afternoon daylight, crisp sunlight, realistic shadows, 4K/8K detail, aggressive handheld tracking, low angles, whip pans, push-ins, crane, speed ramps, brief freeze-frames, motion blur, dust/leaves/debris, coherent physics.

REFERENCE LOCK: Use provided turnaround sheets for BOTH BOYS + NEIGHBOR, plus backyard plate. Lock exact faces, hair, age, proportions, clothing, colors, dirt, BMX, scooter, neighbor's dark bun, sharp face, leopard-print jacket, black pants, gold earrings/shoes, exact backyard layout. Persistent throughout. No redesign, drift, prop/wardrobe changes, morphing, duplication, environment changes.

0–2.5s [24mm handheld tracking]: 11yo red-hoodie BMX rider races through backyard path; 12yo scooter rider bursts from behind shed, closing fast. Camera tracks wheel-height then snaps to terrified face. Pursuer: "STOP!" SFX: tires, chain, scooter rattle, wind.

2.5–4s [Low whip-pan + speed ramp]: BMX banks around garden chairs; scooter nearly clips one. Slow-mo on inches-away wheel, dust suspended, brief freeze-frame, snap to full speed. SFX: skid, scrape, impact hit.

4–6s [Side tracking + crane]: They tear beneath hanging laundry; sheets whip across frame, scooter rider ducks as cloth slaps his face. SFX: fabric whip, wind, wheels.

6–8.5s [Low tracking]: BMX jumps dirt mound, wheels airborne, camera follows spinning tires. Hard landing, rider's body jolts, bike wobbles as he fights to regain balance, rear tire skids, dirt bursts. Scooter closes the gap in the wobble. SFX: impact, dirt burst, chain rattle, grunt.

8.5–10.5s [Whip-pan + snap zoom]: Metal barrel rolls across the path. BMX swerves inches from fence. Panic close-up → freeze-frame → instant full-speed escape. SFX: rolling metal, tire squeal, fence creak.

10.5–13s [Low backward tracking]: Both race side-by-side through the fence/flower corridor, elbows nearly touching, gravel spraying. Scooter boy: "I've got you!" BMX boy: "Not today!" — accelerates ahead. SFX: tires, breathing, wind.

13–15.5s [Fast orbit + speed ramp]: Final straight toward wooden boundary fence. BMX cuts desperately; scooter overshoots, loses control. Camera orbits as trajectories converge. SFX: brakes, gravel, rising tension.

15.5–18s [Extreme slow-mo low angle]: Both crash into the fence. Bike and scooter flip, boards splinter, dust/leaves/wood fragments explode in sunlight. Realistic non-graphic impact. Freeze-frame. SFX: wood crack, metal impact, then sudden silence.

18–20.5s [Handheld shake + 50mm push-in]: Boys lie stunned. Back door SLAMS open — the exact neighbor storms out, furious. Close-up on her intimidating face: "WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY FENCE?!"

20.5–22.5s: Boys trade terrified looks. One whispers: "Run." She steps forward: "DON'T. MOVE."

22.5–24s [Push-in freeze]: Final freeze-frame on her furious face, boys frozen mid-flinch.

FINAL LOOK: authentic skin pores, natural hair, detailed fabrics/wood/grass/metal, realistic daylight, contact shadows, natural lens flare, cinematic DOF, controlled film grain, premium live-action realism. Seedance priority: identity → wardrobe/props → environment → action continuity → camera → effects.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: no face/age changes, no identity drift, no wardrobe/prop swaps, no distorted hands, no floating objects, no impossible physics, no morphing duplicates, no CGI/cartoon look, no plastic skin, no extra limbs, no environment changes, no subtitles, no text, no logos, no watermark.

22.5–24s [push-in freeze]: freeze-frame final sobre su rostro furioso, los niños congelados a mitad del sobresalto.

Tudo persistente ao longo de toda a cena. Sem redesign, drift, mudanças de props/figurino, morphing, duplicação, mudanças no ambiente.

0–2.5s [24mm handheld tracking]: ciclista de BMX de 11 anos com moletom vermelho dispara pelo caminho do quintal; ciclista de scooter de 12 anos surge correndo de trás do galpão, fechando rápido. A câmera acompanha na altura da roda e então corta para o rosto apavorado. Perseguidor: "STOP!" SFX: pneus, corrente, chocalho da scooter, vento.

2.5–4s [Low whip-pan + speed ramp]: BMX contorna as cadeiras de jardim; a scooter quase encosta em uma delas. Slow-mo na roda a centímetros de distância, poeira suspensa, breve freeze-frame, volta instantânea à velocidade total. SFX: derrapagem, raspão, impacto.

4–6s [Side tracking + crane]: Eles rasgam por baixo do varal; lençóis cruzam o quadro com força, o ciclista da scooter se abaixa enquanto o tecido bate no rosto dele. SFX: tecido chicoteando, vento, rodas.

6–8.5s [Low tracking]: BMX salta um monte de terra, rodas no ar, câmera acompanha os pneus girando. SFX: impacto, explosão de terra, chocalho da corrente, grunhido.

8.5–10.5s [Whip-pan + snap zoom]: Um barril de metal rola pelo caminho. BMX desvia a centímetros da cerca. Close-up de pânico → freeze-frame → fuga instantânea em velocidade total. SFX: metal rolando, guincho do pneu, rangido da cerca.

10.5–13s [Low backward tracking]: Os dois correm lado a lado pelo corredor entre a cerca e as flores, cotovelos quase se tocando, cascalho espirrando. Menino da scooter: "I’ve got you!" Menino do BMX: "Not today!" — acelera à frente. SFX: pneus, respiração, vento.

13–15.5s [Fast orbit + speed ramp]: Reta final em direção à cerca de madeira da divisa. O BMX corta desesperadamente; a scooter passa do ponto e perde o controle. A câmera orbita enquanto as trajetórias convergem. SFX: freios, cascalho, tensão crescente.

15.5–18s [Extreme slow-mo low angle]: Os dois batem na cerca. Bike e scooter capotam, tábuas se estilhaçam, poeira/folhas/fragments de madeira explodem sob a luz do sol. Impacto realista, sem gore. Freeze-frame. SFX: madeira quebrando, impacto metálico, depois silêncio súbito.

18–20.5s [Handheld shake + 50mm push-in]: Os meninos ficam atordoados no chão. A porta dos fundos se ESCANCARA — a vizinha exata sai furiosa. Close-up no rosto intimidador dela: "WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY FENCE?!"

20.5–22.5s: Os meninos trocam olhares apavorados. Um sussurra: "Run." Ela dá um passo à frente: "DON'T. MOVE."

22.5–24s [Push-in freeze]: Freeze-frame final no rosto furioso dela, os meninos congelados no meio do sobressalto.

FINAL LOOK: poros de pele autênticos, cabelo natural, tecidos/madeira/grama/metal detalhados, luz do dia realista, sombras de contato, lens flare natural, DOF cinematográfica, grain de filme controlado, realismo premium de live-action. Prioridade Seedance: identidade → figurino/props → ambiente → continuidade da ação → câmera → efeitos.

后院追逐 — SEEDANCE 2.5。超动态、写实的郊区动作喜剧，明亮的傍晚阳光，清晰的日照，真实阴影，4K/8K 细节，激进的手持跟拍，低机位，甩镜，推镜，摇臂，速度变速，短暂定格，运动模糊，尘土/树叶/碎屑，物理逻辑连贯。

REFERENCE LOCK：使用提供的 BOTH BOYS + NEIGHBOR 转面图，以及 backyard plate。锁定精确的脸、头发、年龄、比例、服装、颜色、污渍、BMX、自行车滑板车、邻居的深色发髻、尖锐脸型、豹纹夹克、黑裤子、金色耳环/鞋子、精确的后院布局。全程保持一致。不要重新设计、漂移、替换道具/服装、变形、重复、环境变化。

0–2.5s [24mm 手持跟拍]：11 岁、穿红色连帽衫的 BMX 骑手沿后院小路飞驰；12 岁滑板车骑手从棚屋后猛冲出来，迅速逼近。镜头先跟随轮子高度移动，然后猛地切到他惊恐的脸。追赶者：“STOP！” 音效：轮胎、链条、滑板车震动声、风声。

2.5–4s [低位甩镜 + 速度变速]：BMX 绕过花园椅急转；滑板车几乎擦到一把椅子。轮子近在咫尺的慢动作，尘土悬浮，短暂定格，瞬间切回全速。音效：打滑、刮擦、撞击。

4–6s [侧向跟拍 + 摇臂]：他们冲过晾衣绳下方；床单在画面中猛甩，滑板车骑手低头躲闪，布料拍到他的脸。音效：布料抽打声、风声、车轮声。

6–8.5s [低位跟拍]：BMX 跳过土坡，车轮腾空，镜头跟随旋转的轮胎。重重落地，骑手身体一震，自行车摇晃，他拼命恢复平衡，后轮打滑，尘土炸开。滑板车趁着这一下晃动迅速缩短距离。音效：撞击、尘土爆起、链条震响、闷哼。

8.5–10.5s [甩镜 + 快速变焦]：一个金属桶滚过小路。BMX 紧贴着围栏险险避开。惊恐特写 → 定格 → 立刻恢复全速逃离。音效：金属滚动声、轮胎尖叫、围栏吱呀声。

10.5–13s [低位倒退跟拍]：两人并排穿过围栏/花丛走廊，手肘几乎碰到一起，碎石四溅。滑板车男孩：“我抓到你了！” BMX 男孩：“今天不行！”——随即加速冲到前面。音效：轮胎声、喘息声、风声。

13–15.5s [快速环绕 + 速度变速]：最后直线冲向木质边界围栏。BMX 拼命变向；滑板车冲过头，失去控制。镜头环绕，轨迹逐渐汇合。音效：刹车声、碎石声、紧张感上升。

15.5–18s [极慢动作低角度]：两人一起撞上围栏。自行车和滑板车翻起，木板碎裂，尘土/树叶/木屑在阳光中炸开。真实、非血腥的撞击。定格。音效：木头断裂声、金属撞击声，然后突然安静。

18–20.5s [手持抖动 + 50mm 推镜]：男孩们躺在地上，惊魂未定。后门猛地被撞开——原样的邻居怒气冲冲地冲出来。特写她极具压迫感的脸：“WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY FENCE?!”

20.5–22.5s：两个男孩惊恐对视。其中一个低声说：“Run.” 她向前一步：“DON'T. MOVE.”
